DRAYTHOS QUARTERLY RECONCILIATION SUMMARY
Date: November 1, 2026

1. Purpose and Scope
This document outlines the quarterly multi-format financial reconciliation for all operating divisions.
Revenue recognition follows ASC 606 standards, ensuring that sales tax, value-added tax (VAT), and goods and services tax (GST)
are recognized strictly when the performance obligation is completed.

2. Concept Harmonization
The finance team previously referred to local taxes under separate terminologies:
- 'GST' in Asia-Pacific subsidiaries
- 'VAT' in European business units
- 'Sales Tax' in North American jurisdictions
All three terms are mapped canonically to the unified Tax Compliance dictionary within the Draythos intelligence workspace.

3. Audit Trail and Evidence
Supporting evidence includes attached spreadsheets, vendor invoices, and compliance certificates.
Cross-session isolation ensures that data rooms for distinct legal entities remain completely segregated.
